classes.name: Elección de Presidente y Vicepresidente de la República
classes.finest_note: junta receptora de votos (JRV) for 2014 (HTML); department in the 1994-2009 PDF consolidados
classes.note: A joint ticket elected by direct vote in one national constituency, voters abroad counted since 2014. Under the 1983 text an absolute majority of valid votes elected, otherwise a second election between the top two within 30 days (1984, 1994, and 2014 went to one). D.L. N° 371 of 31 July 2025 (D.O. N° 144, 1 August 2025) amended arts. 80, 133, 152, and 154: a plurality elects, the term is six years, and the transitional article ends the 2024 term on 1 June 2027 so that president, Assembly, and councils are elected together on 28 February 2027. The Consejo Central de Elecciones ran elections until the 1991 constitutional reform created the TSE.

cadence.runoff_rule: Absolute majority of valid votes; otherwise a second election between the two leading parties or coalitions within 30 days (Cn. art. 80, Código Electoral art. 216).

classes.name: Elección de Diputados a la Asamblea Legislativa
classes.finest_note: department in the TSE consolidados and actas; voting center and JRV spreadsheets for 2018 and 2021 were listed but returned 404 on the check date
classes.note: Unicameral, renewed every three years (Cn. art. 124), by list proportional representation (Cn. art. 79). 60 seats in 1985 and 1988; 84 seats from 1991 to 2021, 64 in the 14 departmental constituencies plus 20 on a national list until 2003, then all 84 in the departments; 60 seats in 14 departmental constituencies from 2024 (D.L. N° 755 of 7 June 2023 amending Código Electoral art. 13), allocated by D'Hondt (art. 217) instead of quotient and largest remainder. Open lists with preference marks and cross-voting since 2012 and 2015 (Sala de lo Constitucional rulings). The 2026 reform of Cn. art. 79 allows electoral constituencies abroad as the law determines; for 2027 the votes cast abroad are still added to the departmental constituencies (PLAGEL 2027 SE).

classes.name: Consulta popular sobre el proyecto y bases de la unión centroamericana
classes.name_en: Referendum on a Central American union
classes.locator: https://www.asamblea.gob.sv/sites/default/files/2026-05/1.%20CONSTITUCI%C3%93N%20DE%20LA%20REP%C3%9ABLICA.pdf (art. 89: El proyecto y bases de la unión se someterán a consulta popular)
classes.note: The only national popular vote on a question that the 1983 constitution provides for; none has been held. Constitutional amendments pass by two successive Assemblies (art. 248) with no referendum.

classes.name: Elecciones de segundo grado por la Asamblea Legislativa
classes.name_en: Officials chosen by the Legislative Assembly
classes.locator: https://www.asamblea.gob.sv/sites/default/files/2026-05/1.%20CONSTITUCI%C3%93N%20DE%20LA%20REP%C3%9ABLICA.pdf (art. 131 ords. 17 and 19: elegir por votación nominal y pública)
classes.disposition_reason: Appointments by roll-call vote of the Assembly (Supreme Court and TSE magistrates, Fiscal General, Procuradores, Corte de Cuentas, Consejo Nacional de la Judicatura, and presidential designados), recorded as legislative decrees rather than contested popular elections; the 1982 choice of a provisional president by the Constituent Assembly is one such vote.

classes.name: Elecciones internas de los partidos políticos
classes.name_en: Party internal elections and candidate selection
classes.disposition_reason: Each party's own electoral commission organizes, runs, and declares its internal elections (Ley de Partidos Políticos arts. 37-A and 37-K); the TSE does not run or certify them, and no official body publishes their results.

classes.name: Elección de candidatos a Magistrados de la Corte Suprema por las entidades representativas de los abogados
classes.name_en: Lawyers' vote for Supreme Court candidates
classes.locator: https://www.asamblea.gob.sv/sites/default/files/2026-05/1.%20CONSTITUCI%C3%93N%20DE%20LA%20REP%C3%9ABLICA.pdf (art. 186: la mitad de la cual provendrá de los aportes de las entidades representativas de los abogados)
classes.disposition_reason: A vote of registered lawyers that supplies half the Consejo Nacional de la Judicatura's list of Supreme Court candidates; a professional vote outside the TSE that elects no one to office.

classes.name: Elección de Concejos Municipales
classes.locator: https://www.asamblea.gob.sv/sites/default/files/2026-05/1.%20CONSTITUCI%C3%93N%20DE%20LA%20REP%C3%9ABLICA.pdf (art. 202: Concejos formados de un Alcalde, un Síndico y dos o más Regidores ... elegidos para un período de tres años)
classes.finest_note: municipality in the TSE consolidados; JRV spreadsheets for 2018 and 2021 listed but returned 404 on the check date
classes.note: Each municipality elects its whole council on one party ballot. Until 2012 the winning slate took every seat; since 2015 the party with the most votes takes the mayor and síndico and enough regidores for a majority, and the other regidores go by municipal quotient and largest remainder (Código Electoral arts. 12 and 219). 262 municipalities until 2021; from the 2024 election, 44 municipalities under the Ley Especial para la Reestructuración Municipal (D.L. N° 762 of 13 June 2023), whose 262 former municipalities became districts without elected bodies. Contests count councils.
